items.name_it: Sussidio/prestito CSN per cittadini UE che lavorano in Svezia
items.description: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens who work in Sweden can be treated like Swedish citizens under EU law and get Swedish student finance (grant + loan) for studies in Sweden.

eligibility.min_work_hours: employed at least 10 hours/week for at least 10 weeks before studies, and normally continue working at least 10 hours/week during studies
other: Swiss citizens also need a Swedish residence permit
must study at least 50% for at least 3 weeks
under 60 years old

items.amount: Full-time 2026: SEK 1,030/week grant + SEK 2,368/week loan (SEK 4,120 + 9,472 per 4 weeks)
items.how_to_apply: Apply on CSN Mina sidor, then submit a study assurance at the start of each semester.
items.stackable: Income limit applies (e.g. SEK 114,676 per half-year for 20 weeks of full-time study, 2026).
items.notes: CSN amounts page shows 114,676 SEK in its table but 113,901 SEK in its text for the 20-week income limit; check the CSN decision. Self-employed route also exists (10 h/week for 10 weeks, F-tax, VAT registration).

items.name_it: Sussidio/prestito CSN dopo 5 anni di residenza (diritto di soggiorno permanente)
items.description: EU/EEA citizens with permanent right of residence (normally after five years of uninterrupted legal residence in Sweden) can get Swedish student finance. A 'lasting connection' (e.g. 2 years of at least 50% work in Sweden, or 2 years cohabiting with a partner in Sweden) is an alternative route.

eligibility.residence_requirement: permanent right of residence: normally 5 years of uninterrupted legal residence in Sweden (Swiss: permanent residence permit)
other: alternative: lasting connection to Sweden plus right of residence

items.amount: Same rates as other CSN recipients: SEK 3,398/week full-time grant + loan (2026)

items.name_it: Borsa del Swedish Institute per Global Professionals
items.description: State-funded scholarship for master's studies in Sweden for citizens of 34 eligible countries who are liable to pay tuition fees; requires work and leadership experience. Covers full tuition plus a monthly allowance.

eligibility.min_work_hours: at least 3,000 hours of work experience before February 2027 (no hour minimum for Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, Ukraine)
other: citizen of one of 34 listed countries
liable to pay tuition fees and admitted to an eligible master's programme
EU/EEA citizens and Swedish permanent residents are not eligible

items.amount: Full tuition + SEK 12,000/month living allowance + one-time travel grant SEK 15,000 (SEK 10,000 for some countries); 2027 call
items.how_to_apply: Apply to programmes via University Admissions, then submit the SI application in its portal.
items.notes: Results by end of April 2027. Category 'other' because it is a state scholarship, not CSN finance.

items.name_it: Contributo per l'alloggio per giovani sotto i 29 anni
items.description: Housing allowance for people under 29 without children, whether they study or work. You must normally be registered (folkbokförd) at the home; lodgers (inneboende) are not eligible. Only 60 m² of floor area counts.

eligibility.income_test: gross annual income up to SEK 86,720 (single) or SEK 103,720 combined (couple); CSN studiebidrag counts as income; assets over SEK 100,000 count
eligibility.stay_duration: registered in the Population Register at the address
other: housing cost above SEK 1,800/month (single)
not for lodgers (inneboende)

items.how_to_apply: Apply on Försäkringskassan Mina sidor with proof of housing costs; decision valid up to 12 months.
items.deadline: Paid only from the month you apply; no back-payment
items.stackable: Can be received alongside CSN, but the CSN grant counts as income.

interpretations.hypothesis: Only population-register registration at the home is required, so a registered EU student could qualify.

As a residence-based benefit it may also require being insured in Sweden; Försäkringskassan says EU students' insurance is assessed case by case and non-EU students generally cannot be insured (except for work-based benefits).

items.notes: In practice this mostly concerns students registered for stays of at least one year.

items.name_it: Assicurazione Student IN / FAS+ fornita dall'università (Kammarkollegiet)
items.authority: Kammarkollegiet (Legal, Financial and Administrative Services Agency), via the university
items.description: Universities insure incoming students through the state agency Kammarkollegiet. At Lund, Student IN normally covers exchange students, EU/EEA/Swiss citizens and some fee-exempt students; FAS+ covers non-EU fee-paying students. Cover is for the student only.

other: depends on the university's agreement
not for students already living in Sweden with a personnummer (Lund)

items.amount: No premium charged to the student (KTH student budgets list insurance as SEK 0; cover depends on student category)
items.how_to_apply: Automatic for eligible students; check with your university.
items.stackable: Separate from EHIC, which covers care outside Sweden.
items.notes: Eligibility split described here is Lund's; other universities may differ.

items.description: Under-20s and adult full-time students meeting SL's student-discount conditions (approved student ID) can buy all SL tickets at the reduced price.

other: full-time student with approved student ID (SL's specific conditions)
or under 20

items.amount: 30-day ticket at reduced price: SEK 325 during the 2026 half-price campaign (buy/activate by 2 Dec 2026); KTH 2026 budget lists SEK 650/month for the student ticket
items.how_to_apply: Buy a reduced-price ticket in the SL app or on an SL card; carry student ID.
items.notes: The ordinary (post-campaign) reduced price was not shown on SL's page; SEK 650 comes from KTH's budget. Adult campaign price SEK 530.

items.description: Students can buy Period Ticket Youth (30, 90 or 365 days), 25% off adult period tickets. Not valid on single or day tickets.

eligibility.stay_duration: studying at least part time for at least 10 consecutive weeks
other: studies giving entitlement to CSN (university or adult education)
student ID app with the student travel symbol valid for the whole ticket period

items.amount: Zone A 30-day youth/student ticket SEK 670 (regular), SEK 335 during the 2026 half-price offer (until 2 Dec 2026)
items.how_to_apply: Buy Period Ticket Youth in the Västtrafik To Go app; carry student ID and passport/ID card.
items.stackable: Cannot be combined with the City of Gothenburg resident subsidy or 'Travel 4, pay for 1'.

items.description: Students get 25% off all ordinary tickets for travel within Skåne (not campaign tickets) and 35% off 30-day and Flex tickets to Denmark.

other: valid student ID with student symbol in an app from Mecenat, Studentkortet/STUK, Hitract, WeStudents or Orbi
valid ID document

items.amount: 25% off ordinary Skåne tickets; 35% off 30-day tickets to Denmark (prices not shown on page)
items.how_to_apply: Choose the student price when buying; show student ID and ID on inspection.

items.description: Students studying at least 75% can buy UL tickets at the reduced price with a valid student ID.

other: studying at least 75%
student ID from Mecenat, STUK, WeStudent or Orbi with SL logo

items.amount: 30-day ticket SEK 850 reduced (adult SEK 1,150); campaign SEK 425 reduced for tickets activated by 2 Dec 2026
items.how_to_apply: Buy in the UL app or webshop at the reduced price; carry student ID.

items.name_it: Sconto comunale sull'abbonamento per residenti a Göteborg
items.description: The City of Gothenburg subsidises 16% of adult Zone A period tickets bought in the Västtrafik To Go app by registered residents. Not for youth/student tickets.

eligibility.stay_duration: registered as resident in Gothenburg (population register)
other: adult Zone A 30/90/365-day ticket in the To Go app
Västtrafik account

items.amount: 30-day Zone A SEK 720 instead of SEK 860 (from 27 April 2026)
items.how_to_apply: Log in to Västtrafik To Go; the price is applied automatically.
items.stackable: Not combinable with the student discount.
items.notes: Västtrafik's half-price page lists different pre-campaign figures (adult Zone A SEK 890, residents SEK 750); prices conflict between pages.

other: nominated under an exchange agreement

items.notes: Verified for Lund only; non-EU exchange students still need a residence permit.
